title: Compress source LoRA bank before composition
hypothesis: A small Mirror source-code bank can preserve compositions of many pretrained LoRA modules with lower total bytes and composition compute than LoRAHub's uncompressed source bank, and must beat native VeRA/shared-scaling controls.
physical_object: Shared rank-1 LoRA atom factors plus a small common source-adapter coefficient basis
mirror_coordinate: Per-source coordinates and composed-target codes over shared LoRA atoms; private rank-2 source residuals handle off-basis variation
logical_multiplicity: 16 target adapters composed from 16/64 source LoRA modules

task.metric: Held-out composed-output NRMSE, actual complete inference payload bytes, composition MAC proxy and inference MAC proxy

development.selection_metric: Quality/state-bytes/composition-compute frontier; no target coefficient search or fresh tuning

controls: LoRAHub-style full source LoRA factor bank plus dense target composition coefficients
Independent full composed target matrices as deployment upper control
Mirror shared atom basis with source and precomposed target codes
Native VeRA-style shared left/right rank-1 matrices and source scaling vectors, identical function decoder
Shared basis plus source private residual factors and charged target coefficients

storage.authority: Actual serialized complete inference payload bytes
paid_objects: source LoRA factors or shared atoms

compute: serialization and inference CPU wall time
success_gate: At residual 0 and both source-bank sizes, Mirror composed-output NRMSE <=0.02 and complete payload <=50% of LoRAHub source bank plus coefficients; composition compute must not exceed LoRAHub. Mirror-specific success additionally requires a strict gain over VeRA/shared scaling in at least one Pareto axis without losing quality or another axis.
failure_gate: Quality/bytes/compute gate misses or Mirror exactly aliases VeRA/native shared scaling without a strict Pareto gain. Development exact native alias permits fresh to remain sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic linear adapter composition only; no LoRAHub paper benchmark or language-model task
Target composition coefficients are supplied by a fixed synthetic task construction, isolating source-bank compression from search (MA-669 tested coefficient search)
Source matrices are LoRA rank-6 or lower; all source factors are paid
For residual-free targets, precomposed target codes replace target coefficients; with private residuals, target coefficients are retained and charged
Logical combination count is credited only through measured composed-output quality
